purpose: Check actual hidden-input linear response through a complete pretrained encoding/decoding chain; no source classifier or selected threshold
selection: Lowest original raw-file SHA within each domain×label, restricted to historicalfit. No feature values used.
preprocessing: Stored orientation RGB; shared bicubic square resize_unit_float, then float64[-1,1]. This is controlled probe preprocessing, not native generator resolution or physical capture.
encoder_posterior: mean after quant_conv; no sampling and no diffusion latent scaling
decoder: post_quant_conv then full source Decoder, original weights, CPUfloat64, vanilla attention
metrics: Pointwise prediction using measured hidden tensors; descriptive2×2 spatial means/variances for sublayers and final RGB/luma/Laplacian, not ensemble or significance estimates. Labels only preserved as provenance, never used by model or metric.
pass_conditions: All selected source files match registered SHA and native dimensions
Every component loads all matching released parameters strictly
All3 upsampling sublayers match an independently indexed NumPy prediction on actual hidden inputs
Every layer's planted output corruption is rejected
Undefined constant-field summaries retained, not classified
No original/processed detector inference, fitting orBA evaluation
scientific_limits: Encoding/decoding original inputs is not their original generation process
128px probes do not reproduce native model sample distribution
Spatial phase summaries may reflect scene, resizing and boundaries
No matching photography-processing specificity test or real propagation validation
